quest.title: Wild Escape
quest.description: Venti's plan to steal the Holy Lyre went off without a hitch. Well, almost — when the Lyre was almost in your hands, a stranger stole it from under your noses. Your movements alerted the guards, forcing you to flee the Cathedral.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Mora x5450, Character EXP x2850, Fine Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Use the wind currents to get far away from the Cathedral

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I say we make a run for the tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why would we wanna do that!?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: We can blend in with the crowd of drinkers.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Also, in all the commotion my wandering hands would go unnoticed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You are gross! Just wait till we're out of this and Paimon will teach you a lesson!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Master Diluc, this is this week's accounts.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hmm... The disaster has greatly affected business.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Well, let's hope it all ends soon.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hi, we'd like a seat at your, uhh... least conspicuous table.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Umm... The second floor has fewer customers. You'd be less conspicuous up there...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: But aren't you a bard? Why not sit front and center?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hahaha, let's save the paid performance for next time. We'll be heading up now, see you in a bit!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hey, keep an eye on them. There's something strange about that bard. I'll go ask around.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Ask who exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: The "protectors" of Mondstadt...

talks.objective: Hide on the second floor of the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: Ah, Master Diluc. Have you seen two thieves around?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: What happened? Why have you mobilized so many guards?

dialogues.speaker: Miles
dialogues.text: Haven't you heard, Master Diluc? Two thieves were trying to steal the Holy Lyre!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Oh? How odd.

dialogues.speaker: Miles
dialogues.text: Isn't it? The Holy Lyre is a treasure that was played by the God of Anemo themselves. Such a precious piece of cultural heritage—

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Why would one want to steal something they can't sell off? Would pay better to steal from my cellars...

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Sorry, off topic. Believe they headed that way.

dialogues.speaker: Miles
dialogues.text: Understood. Thank you, Master Diluc!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Today I think I'll have a glass of...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: You can put down that bottle you stole from behind the counter.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: ...something cold.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Right. I want answers.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Lemme finish my drink first? I'll pay you — well, with a performance.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: It's not about money. You seem too young to be drinking.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: No need to worry. When I started drinking, you were still—

choices.text: How about answering my question first?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oh, you wanna ask "Who's this?" Am I right?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: He is Master <color=#00E1FFFF>Diluc</color>, the boss of... ah, the owner of this tavern.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: He's very famous. By the way, his dandelion wine is one of my favorites.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Though most of the time I can only afford a bottle or two...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I just heard about some thieves from the guards.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: For the record, I like your guts for trying to steal the Holy Lyre der Himmel.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Even if you are fools... but we don't often get to see people like you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It wasn't us that stole it! The real thief is still out there!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: This is the hotshot of the Knights of Favonius. Why would someone so aspiring steal Mondstadt's sacred treasure?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Hotshot...? Oh, so it's you.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: So, you and the bard are close friends?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Well... Despite only being a passing traveler, you still offered your help to Mondstadt in its time of need.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: A shame you joined the Knights.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: The Knights of Favonius... Inefficient right from beginning to end.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: And towards the <color=#00E1FFFF>Fatui</color>? Weak and conservative.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Forget it. I don't feel like talking about it.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Seems you don't really like the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Just differences in approach is all.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I have my own hopes for this city.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Now, answers. Why did you steal the Holy Lyre?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: You sure you want to know? It could implicate you in the affairs of the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: That's fine. I somehow always end up implicated in their affairs.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: If I tell you the story with a performance, will you believe me?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: It depends. I'll make my own judgment.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Then will I get paid?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Your reward will range from anywhere between five Mora and the Holy Lyre. It all depends on your story.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Very well. Let me put on a show...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: What did I just witness...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: This is confidential information. Why did you let me know?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Why? Hmm... Perhaps the winds are changing.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: What say you, Master Diluc?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Interesting.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Give me some time. I'll organize some contacts.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Outlander, as one of the Knights, it seems you're not a suspect.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Blonde is the only description on the wanted poster. You should be safe.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: As for the bard however, it'd be better if you stayed in the tavern.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Haha. No problem! I like taverns.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Okay. Let's meet here tonight after the tavern closes.

choices.text: I've only heard him play once.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Okay then. You just need to follow the <color=#00E1FFFF>marked route</color> to the finish.
